1842 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
299 days before 1842-11-29:  
Step back 29 days → 1842-10-31.  
Remaining 270 days: go back 9 months (Jan–Sep have 273 days in total for non-leap year).  
270 days earlier from Oct 31: Oct has 31 days, so Oct 31 → Sep 30 (1 day), then back 269 more days into early 1842.  
Better: 299 days = 9 months (Jan 31, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31) = 273 days + 26 days.  
From Nov 29, subtract 273 days (9 months back) → Feb 28? Let’s check: Nov 29 → Oct 29 (30 days) → Sep 29 (61) → Aug 29 (92) → Jul 29 (123) → Jun 29 (153) → May 29 (184) → Apr 29 (214) → Mar 29 (245) → Feb 28? 1842 Feb has 28 days, so Mar 1 is day 60 from Jan 1. Actually easier:  
Count days in 1842 before Nov 29: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 + Oct 31 + 29 days in Nov = 31+28=59, +31=90, +30=120, +31=151, +30=181, +31=212, +31=243, +30=273, +31=304, +29=333 days elapsed in year.  
So Nov 29 is day 333 of 1842.  
333 − 299 = day 34 of 1842.  
Day 34 of non-leap year: Jan 31 (day 31), Feb 28 (day 59), so day 34 = Feb 3.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1842-02-03
